items.title: JPMorgan Cut Its IREN Target to $55. It Still Sees 148% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysJPMorgan cut its IREN price target to $55 from $65 on Monday and kept its Overweight rating, leaving 148% upside after a 68% drop in a year. IREN pushed its $4 billion revenue run-rate target into early 2027 after Microsoft asked for a network upgrade, and $6 billion of this fiscal year’s build still needs funding.
